factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows total assets increased from 39,568 thousand euros as of 31 December 2024 to 42,728 thousand euros as of 31 March 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased to 42728 thousand euros as of 31 March 2025, compared to 39568 thousand euros at the end of December 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: 'TOTAL ASSETS Q1 2025: 42,728 (31 December 2024: 39,568)'.

factual_claims.claim: Inventories rose to 32329 thousand euros from 29170 thousand euros, reflecting ongoing investments in properties under development, including the acquisition of a new development property at Spordi Street in Tallinn during the quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 10 (Inventories): 'Total inventories Q1 2025: 32,329 (31 December 2024: 29,170)'. Operating report states: 'In Q1 2025 the group acquired a property with building permit at Spordi 3a, 3b Kristiine Tallinn.'

factual_claims.claim: Total equity attributable to owners of the parent stood at 19842 thousand euros at the end of March 2025, showing a slight increase from 19739 thousand euros at year end 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity: 'Balance as of 31 March 2025: Total equity attributable to owners of the parent: 19,842 (Balance as of 31 December 2024: 19,739)'.

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing liabilities increased to 16568 thousand euros as of 31 March 2025, up from 15215 thousand euros at the end of 2024, driven by new bank loan financing secured for construction activities at Rannakalda and the Spordi project.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 12 (Interest bearing liabilities): 'Total Q1 2025: 16,568 (31 December 2024: 15,215)'. Note 12 details new loans: '900 thousand euros of bank loan for financing construction of apartment buildings in Kodulahe Rannakalda' and '2,190 thousand euros of bank loan for Sports 3a, 3b land loan'.

factual_claims.claim: Net loans reached 15455 thousand euros, while cash and cash equivalents decreased to 1113 thousand euros from 1720 thousand euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Ratios section: 'Net loans at the end of period Q1 2025: 15,455 (Q1 2024: 10,559)'. Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: 'Cash and cash equivalents Q1 2025: 1,113 (31 December 2024: 1,720)'.

factual_claims.claim: The weighted average annual interest rate of interest-bearing liabilities was 8.2% at the end of Q1 2025, representing a decrease of 0.5 percentage points compared to 31 December 2024, aided by declining Euribor rates.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Ratios: 'Average annual interest rate of loans Q1 2025: 8.2% (Q1 2024: 7.8%)'. Liquidity and interest rate risks section: 'The group’s weighted average loan interest rate was 8.2% as of 31 March 2025. This is an decrease by 0.5 percentage points compared to the end of year 2024. The decrease in the average interest rate on loan liabilities is due to the decrease in Euribor.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating activities used net cash of 2838 thousand euros, while financing activities generated 2231 thousand euros, resulting in a net cash decrease of 607 thousand euros for the quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: 'NET CASH FROM/USED IN OPERATING ACTIVITIES Q1 2025: -2,838 (Q1 2024: -2,217)'. 'NET CASH FROM/USED IN FINANCING ACTIVITIES Q1 2025: 2,231 (Q1 2024: 1,479)'. 'NET CASH FLOW Q1 2025: -607 (Q1 2024: -738)'.

factual_claims.claim: Overall, the first quarter of 2025 demonstrated a solid operational recovery and continued progression across the group's active residential development projects in Estonia and Bulgaria.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report summary: 'In summary, Q1 2025 was a period of stability and preparation, with the real estate market moving quietly but steadily toward recovery.' Also supported by the financial improvement detailed throughout the report.
